title: Framework Development
subtitle: Write, challenge, and deepen the governance frameworks
heroIntro: There are already several dozen frameworks here, and the set is broad rather than deep. The most useful contributions are usually not new frameworks but domain expertise applied to existing ones — including telling us where they're wrong.
